items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: In the Panther Room, they had Harry James' band and Frank Sinatra, so we worked with them for about a month.

ctx.x: Slim Gaillard was workin' with him. Him an' Slam Stewart was together. So, I played there for a coupla years, an' I took off, went back to New York, played again the Apollo Theater, back up in Washington again, played some nightclubs up there, then I left an' come back to New York again.

And then I...me an' Pete Johnson, Albert Ammons, Meade Lux Lewis...we got together an' we run in...we got a bookin' in Chicago at the Panther Room. In the Panther Room, they had Harry James' band and Frank Sinatra, so we worked with them for about a month.

Frank Sinatra and Harry James...Harry James had a date to come to California. Frank Sinatra didn't have none. He was goin' back to New York, so I talked him into comin' to California with Harry James. I tol' him to come on out...t'come...go to California...he might get in movin' pictures. So he had his wife an' his children...all his children in a hotel. They were just but kids then so they used to walk aroun' with 'im in the Panther Room. Long swords with sissabobs [shish kebob] with meat an' tomatoes, potatoes…
